basis: Hereditary choroidal dystrophy and atrophy affect the eye.
Melanoma arising in skin; metastatic sites are not defining organ involvement.
Retinal dystrophy, obesity and polydactyly define BBS; developmental delay in 2/2. Renal, cardiac and pancreatic findings omitted at the four-axis cap.
Hidradenitis suppurativa is an immune-mediated inflammatory follicular disease causing recurrent abscesses and scarring.
Partial 20q duplication syndromes feature developmental impairment and skeletal malformations; other organ defects vary with the duplicated interval.
Urea-cycle metabolic defect; hepatic failure occurs in 30-79%. Supplied neurologic damage phenotypes are individually below 30%.
Invasive carcinoma originates in urinary bladder urothelium; bladder belongs to the renal axis.
Congenital unilateral deficiency or absence of the fibula.
Malignant tumour occupies the brainstem.
Primary osteolysis of tali, patellae and scaphoids with synovitis; definition explicitly excludes renal disease.
Lichen planopilaris variant with immune-mediated destruction and fibrosis of scalp hair follicles.
Hearing abnormalities 80-99%; multicystic renal dysplasia 30-79%. Strabismus (80-99%) and dental disease (30-79%) omitted at the four-axis cap.
Inherited haemoglobin disorder causing thalassaemic anaemia; skeletal disease varies with severity, and iron-related organ injury is often treatment-associated.
Inherited renal tubular glycine transport disorder causing excessive urinary glycine loss; distinct from hyperglycinaemic encephalopathy.
Ellis-van Creveld parent supports common dental dysplasia (>50%) and cardiac malformations (~50-60%), alongside skeletal/nail disease; situs inversus itself is non-damaging.
Defective UV repair causes chronic skin damage. Ocular lesions are reported, but damaging involvement in at least 30% of group E is not established here.
Microphthalmia and coloboma define the disease; holoprosencephaly and orofacial clefts occur in only 5-29%.
Proline-metabolism disorder with cutis laxa and defining joint/hip abnormalities; developmental delay 5/5, intellectual disability 3/6 and callosal agenesis 2/3.
Joint contractures, renal tubulopathy and cholestasis define ARC; ichthyosis occurs in roughly 40-50%. Acid-base abnormalities omitted at cap; CNS/platelet findings variable.
Inherited coagulation defect defined by venous thrombosis. Retinal and destructive skin disease mainly characterize severe biallelic deficiency, not most across this umbrella.
Breast is outside the 13 axes; metastases and rare histological subtypes do not define the umbrella label.
Skeletal dysplasia; dermatitis 1/2, thrombocytopenia 1/2, heart failure and pulmonary arterial hypertension each 1/3. Respiratory distress alone does not establish lung injury.
Defined by pulmonary fibrosis and/or marrow failure; fibrosis in 3/4. Immune, skin, nail and oral abnormalities each occur in only 1/4.
Monoclonal plasma-cell/light-chain disorder with damaging renal deposition in essentially all; symptomatic cardiac and hepatic involvement are rare.
Congenital dysplasia of the anal sphincter affects anorectal function; anus belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
